acme_ops_julia: Hey @jordan_support — after our IdP cert rollover tonight a bunch of users get 403 when they try to SSO into our app. We rolled the certs via the IdP console and updated metadata URL. ACS URL hasn't changed on our side. Any ideas?

jordan_support: sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the error from our logs (SAML response/relay) or an example request ID? quick things: are you seeing a specific error in the assertion (Audience/Recipient) or a signature validation failure?

acme_ops_julia: here's a truncated log from our edge: 
```
2024-11-02T02:12:11Z ERROR saml: assertion validation failed tenant=acme code=403 status=Responder
reason=Signed XML does not match known key: X509Certificate missing or incorrect chain
request_id=R-93012
```
We also ran a samltrace in the browser and IdP seems to return a different cert fingerprint than the one in metadata.

ingrid_cs: @acme_ops_julia thanks — two likely causes: (1) IdP pushed a new signing cert but metadata served to our SP edge still has the old cert (metadata cache TTL), or (2) intermediate chain not included so signature validation fails. Did you upload metadata XML that included the full KeyDescriptor block?

acme_ops_julia: we uploaded the metadata XML the IdP generated. here's the KeyDescriptor snippet (redacted) — pasted from the IdP UI: 
```
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>MIIC...NEWCERT...Q==</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
```
No intermediate cert entries in that blob.

jordan_support: OK that's useful. Two action items from support side: (A) can you confirm the metadata URL you gave us? sometimes a CDN or proxy serves stale metadata (we saw cloudfront caching cases). (B) run `openssl s_client -showcerts -connect idp.example.com:443` and paste the chain — we need to see if IdP is missing intermediates.

acme_ops_julia: metadata URL is https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata.xml (we added that this morning). Running the openssl command now, output attached — looks like the IdP is only serving the leaf cert; intermediate not present.

jordan_support: that lines up. Our SP will try to verify signature against the cert in the metadata. If the IdP rotates and metadata omits intermediates, some of our verification paths will fail depending on which CA anchor is trusted. Two short-term fixes: (1) ask IdP admin to include the full chain in the metadata X509Certificate elements (or include certificate chain in the TLS stack), or (2) as a workaround we can pin the previous cert for 24h while they fix the metadata, if you can provide the prior cert fingerprint.

acme_ops_julia: we still have the old cert fingerprint, yes. Would you support a pin on your side? We have users blocked.

jordan_support: I can open a short-lived pin request with oncall. @tal_oncall — can you assist with a temporary SP cert pin for tenant=acme? We need pin TTL=4h, reason=IdP missing intermediate post-rotate, requestor=acme_ops_julia.

tal_oncall: acknowledged. Before I make changes: our policy requires a safe rollback plan. Two checks: (1) confirm the previous cert fingerprint (sha256) and (2) confirm there are no overlapping key IDs that would cause ambiguity for other tenants. Please paste fingerprint here.

acme_ops_julia: fingerprint: SHA256:aa:bb:cc:dd:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:00:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:00

jordan_support: thanks. While oncall reviews, a few reproducible checks you can run to verify fix: (1) use SAML tracer to export the full Response and run `xmlsec1 --verify --pubkey-cert-pem /path/to/metadata/cert.pem response.xml` to see verification errors; (2) curl the metadata URL with cache-busting header `Cache-Control: no-cache` and verify the X509Certificate block contains the expected cert; (3) confirm ACS Recipient and Audience in the assertion match exactly (trailing slash / vs no slash is common).

acme_ops_julia: quick note — our ACS is `/sso/consume` (no trailing slash). The IdP assertion has Recipient=https://app.acme.com/sso/consume/ (with trailing slash). Could that alone cause the 403 in combination with the cert issue?

ingrid_cs: yes, Recipient mismatch will also cause validation to fail (our SP checks exact match). If you can, ask IdP to normalize ACS to the exact URL or we can add an alias mapping on our side for the tenant. That said, the signature error in your logs suggests signature validation is the primary blocker right now.

acme_ops_julia: understood. We're pinging IdP to add intermediate cert to metadata and adjust Recipient. Appreciate the pin while we coordinate. Any follow-up needed from our side?

jordan_support: please confirm when IdP metadata is updated (link or updated `lastModified` timestamp). Once they update, we'll clear the pin and watch for errors. If you want, paste a sanitized `response.xml` and we can run a local verify here. Also include an example `SAMLResponse` ID for failed attempts so we can correlate logs.

acme_ops_julia: will do. attaching updated metadata URL after they push the fix. thanks all :thumbsup:

samlbot: automation note — metadata watcher detected a change at 2024-11-02T02:45:07Z for idp.acme.com; new fingerprint SHA256: 11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff:00:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff

jordan_support: SAMLBOT shows metadata changed. acme, can you confirm the new metadata includes intermediate? If yes, we'll start validation on our side and I will notify once pin is cleared.
